label: Scared
description: -2 to Bravery until they avoid something difficult. Cleared when they give in to the fear, or when another character comforts them.

label: Angry
description: -2 to Cunning until they hurt someone or break something. Cleared when they give in to the anger, or when a friend calms them.

label: Stressed
description: -2 to Intellect until they say something hurtful to someone. Cleared when they give in to the stress, or when another character supports them.

label: Jealous
description: -2 to Loyalty until they betray a friend. Cleared when they give in to the jealousy, or when another character comforts them.

label: Embarrassed
description: -2 to Magic until they take a comment the wrong way. Cleared when they give in to the embarrassment, or when another character supports them.

label: Injured
description: -1 to all traits until healed with medicine or magic, which the Narrator decides.

label: Hexed
description: -1 to one trait the Narrator chooses, until cured. Give the penalty as a modifier to the roll it affects.

label: Unconscious
description: Unable to act until revived. The witch or wizard can avoid it by taking a different Condition instead.
